- Wave is the service wave of the Ownership Map v1 Services sheet (Architecture v5). A story whose business-epic wave is earlier than its service wave keeps the earlier wave (Template and Rules R5.6).

- The source module and the squad are the words of the version 2 Structure sheet: squad 1 carries the data engine, case and workflow, rules component, access, valuation and route, assets and auction and deviations; squad 2 carries the document hub, communications, decision center and log, settlement, litigation, debt sale and write-off.

- rwb-decision (P7) appears in both module lists: the decision center and log is squad 2, the rules component is the embedded Drools kit that squad 1 builds for every service (CG-B-DELIVDOC-49-2; ASM-B-DELIVDOC-49-2).

- The six services with no module in the Structure sheet carry the R9 placeholder for the squad, and the squad is agreed at the first daily review as the Structure sheet says (CG-B-DELIVDOC-49-3; ASM-B-DELIVDOC-49-3).

- Story slices and legacy stories are counts of the plan, not new estimates. Legacy stories count the stories whose primary service is the row; story slices count every planned story in the row's scope, including the slices of a legacy story whose primary service is another. They show the size of the work each service puts on its squad, not the number of people it needs.
